mechanism_narrative: ERBB4+INSR forced proximity via flexible_GS4 linker biases signaling toward MAPK/ERK and PI3K/AKT pathways via transphosphorylation-recruited GRB2-SHC1 and PIK3R1 adaptors, while sterically excluding PLCG1/Ca2+ and YAP1 WW-domain signaling due to the asymmetric ECD geometry (ERBB4 ~615aa vs INSR ~917aa). The resulting transcriptional output upregulates muscle structural and contractile genes (MYH, ACTA, TPM, TNNT families) via SRF/ELK activation downstream of MAPK, and suppresses aged-enriched immediate early genes (EGR1, FOS, JUN) and inflammatory mediators (IL32, IL6), mirroring the rejuvenating signature observed in prior ERBB2+FGFR wins.
